visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a simple centered-hero gradient layout (2019) to increasingly complex full-bleed compositions with illustrated elements and product mockups (2022–present), while maintaining consistent feature-first messaging and blue/white color hierarchy. Visual sophistication increased through incorporation of detailed interface screenshots, annotation graphics, and more intricate information hierarchy.
